title: Billing and Cancellation Manual: Owner Auto Policy Term Activation and Cancellation from Inception
content:
**Going in force.** A bound Owner Auto Policy term goes in force only when the down payment on its billing plan has cleared, meaning the plan's status shows current or paid in full. This is read from the billing plan's own record. A bound term whose down payment is still pending stays bound.

**Cancellation from inception.** A term is cancelled from inception only when its down payment was returned dishonored. This is read from the billing plan's ledger.

A term cancelled from inception never provided coverage:
- every premium written on it is returned;
- its policy fee is reversed;
- its cancellation effective date and closed date equal the term effective date.

| Down payment | Term status |
|---|---|
| cleared (plan current or paid in full) | in force |
| pending | stays bound |
| returned dishonored | cancelled from inception |
